name: supermarket-simulator
description: Supermarket Life Simulator - grow a corner shop into a mega hypermarket (Android & iOS)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
